+def build_order(graph):
+    """Build task order from dependency graph.
+
+    Args:
+        graph: dict mapping task names to list of prerequisite names
+
+    Returns:
+        List of tasks in topological order
+
+    Raises:
+        ValueError: If there's a cycle in the graph
+    """
+    # Get all tasks (keys and values that are used as prerequisites)
+    all_tasks = set(graph.keys())
+
+    for prereq in graph.values():
+        if isinstance(prereq, list):
+            all_tasks.update(prereq)
+
+    # Build unique prerequisite mapping
+    prereq_graph = {}
+    for task, prereqs in graph.items():
+        unique_prereqs = sorted(set(prereqs))  # sort for determinism but not needed for correctness
+        prereq_graph[task] = set(unique_prereqs)
+
+    # Track completion of tasks
+    completed = set()
+    result = []
+
+    while len(result) < len(all_tasks):
+        # Find all tasks whose prerequisites are satisfied
+        available = [t for t in all_tasks if t not in completed and prereq_graph[t].issubset(completed)]
+
+        if not available:
+            raise ValueError("Cycle detected in dependency graph")
+
+        # Select lexicographically smallest
+        next_task = min(available)
+
+        result.append(next_task)
+        completed.add(next_task)
+
+    return result
